jobs.title: Director Growth Marketing
jobs.description:
Welcome to Glow25!

At Glow25, we unite beauty with science and cutting-edge technology – AI is a natural part of our everyday work. As Germany's leading collagen brand, we help people feel confident at every life stage and enhance their natural beauty.

For our continued growth, we're looking for people with substance: reliable, motivated, and genuinely invested in building something meaningful together. At Glow25, you'll find ambitious goals and an environment that fosters ownership and values performance—regardless of which role you take on.

We look forward to getting to know you.

These are our current challenges and future goals:

We are looking for a Director Growth Marketing to take ownership of Glow25's growth engine. At the core of this role is hands-on, end-to-end full-funnel marketing — someone who can build and run that engine personally, scale the brand internationally, and turn customer lifetime value into a durable competitive advantage.

This is where we need your support:

  • Own full-funnel marketing end-to-en. From top-of-funnel awareness through acquisition, conversion and retention - as the primary engine for scaling Glow25 internationally.

  • Orchestrate all marketing channel; paid, organic, social, CRM and affiliate to ensure a consistently high ROAS across the funnel.

  • Drive growth of eCommerce & marketplaces as a key revenue channel.

  • Leverage customer lifetime value by building out CRM, subscription and loyalty programs that deepen retention and repeat purchase.

  • Acquire market share in the collagen category and adjacent categories through sharp positioning and disciplined execution.

  • Create differentiated brand positioning versus competitors, sharpening how Glow25 shows up against the broader collagen and wellness set.

You have the following experience:

  • Hands-on, full-funnel marketing expertise, this is the core of the role, with a demonstrated track record of continuously improving conversion rates.

  • D2C full-funnel marketing experience gained in a start-up and/or scale-up environment.

  • An analytical, tech-driven marketing profile, comfortable setting up AI-driven campaign workflows and acting on data.

  • A track record of managing and delivering against ambitious growth targets.

  • Comfortable operating in an entrepreneurial setup - fast-paced, dynamic and agile.

  • Fluent English is a must; German on top would be ideal.

Ideally, you also bring:

  • Experience leading the internationalization of a D2C brand.

  • Experience supporting a D2C brand's transition into an omnichannel brand.

That's something you can look forward to:

  • Work flexibly, in the way that suits you best. Work when and where you’re most productive – with flexible hours and smart time tracking.

  • Home office? Done right. We’ve got you covered: receive a one-time €500 allowance to set up your perfect workspace.

  • Fully equipped from day one. Mac or Windows – you choose what works best for you.

  • Glow Card – your monthly treat. Get €50 every month to spend however you like – that’s €600 a year, just because.

  • Learning is part of the deal. Whether it’s our Glowcademy, dedicated learning time, or personal development support – we invest in you, not just in numbers.

  • Let’s Glow! Enjoy 40% off our entire product range – yes, everything.

  • Take a break – you’ve earned it. 30 vacation days + 1 personal holiday + up to 10 additional unpaid days off when you need a real reset. Oh, and New Year’s Eve? That’s a day off too!

  • Stay healthy, stay glowing. Our company health insurance reimburses up to €600 per year for extras like vision aids, alternative medicine, or dental cleanings.

  • Thinking ahead. After your probation period, we’ll contribute €600 toward your pension plan – and if you add more, we’ll top it up with an extra 20%.

  • Exclusive partner perks. Get access to discounts and special offers from top brands through our corporate benefit platforms.

  • Culture that truly shines. For five years in a row, we’ve been recognized as a Top Company on Kununu - proof of the strong, positive, and genuine culture we live every day.

  • Move your way. From workouts to wellness retreats – you decide how to stay active. Choose between Urban Sports Club or Wellpass.

Why Glow25?

You'll take the growth engine of one of Europe's fastest-growing collagen brands and shape its next chapter — with real ownership, a data-rich environment, and the mandate to build a full-funnel marketing organization from a position of scale rather than zero.

jobs.description:
For this position we source for our sister company Troostwijk.

About us

Troostwijk & the TBAuctions group are part of one of Europe’s leading networks for digital B2B auctions. We market machines, vehicles, equipment and other commercial assets, bringing sellers and buyers together through digital processes and personal support.

What your day-to-day work will involve

As an Account Manager, you will develop the French seller market and act as the main point of contact for new and existing sellers. You will build a profitable portfolio, develop long-term relationships based on trust and guide opportunities from the first conversation through to active auction business.

The role combines remote work with regular travel and gives you direct influence on the development of our French market.

You will receive professional support from our teams and work with modern tools that help you structure your pipeline, follow-ups and seller relationships.

What this means in practice

  • Identify, approach and acquire new sellers in the French market.
  • Develop a profitable seller portfolio and build long-term relationships based on trust.
  • Research companies and market opportunities and turn them into relevant conversations.
  • Present our activities and value proposition clearly to business owners and potential sellers.
  • Prepare meetings, understand seller needs and agree on clear next steps.
  • Own negotiations and follow opportunities through to conversion.
  • Keep pipeline, follow-ups and seller information structured with modern tools.
  • Represent our company image and values in the market and coordinate closely with internal teams.
What matters in this role

We are looking for someone who enjoys building a market rather than only maintaining an existing portfolio. You should be comfortable creating your own pipeline, speaking confidently with business owners, handling rejection and staying focused until opportunities move forward.

What you should bring

  • Proven experience in sales, business development or new-business acquisition.
  • Experience in a technical, industrial or B2B environment with measurable commercial results.
  • Strong communication, negotiation, closing and relationship-building skills.
  • Autonomy, commercial drive, persistence and a results-oriented approach.
  • Willingness to travel regularly and a valid Category B driving licence.
  • French as a native language and the ability to work in English.

A perfect CV is less important than your ability to create relationships, develop a territory and turn commercial opportunities into long-term seller business.

What we offer

Autonomy with professional support

You will own your territory and your seller relationships while working closely with internal teams that support you with expertise, coordination and operational follow-through. You will not be left alone with complex opportunities or process questions.

Build something with visible impact

The role gives you the opportunity to help establish the French market, shape long-term seller relationships and contribute directly to recurring auction activity. Your work combines commercial ownership with professional development.

Performance that pays off

You can expect an attractive compensation package with a competitive fixed salary and a bonus model that recognises your individual performance.

Your benefits

Company car, computer, phone and meal tickets support you in your day-to-day work.

Do you have a track record in B2B sales and want to help build the French seller market? We look forward to hearing from you.

jobs.description:
Wir sind PsyCurio, ein HealthTech-Startup, das Psychotherapie mit Virtual Reality neu denkt. Wir bauen eine VR-gestützte Therapie-Infrastruktur, die Therapeut:innen im klinischen Alltag entlastet und Patient:innen Zugang zu strukturierten, wirksamen und modernen Übungen ermöglicht, etwa bei Angststörungen, Suchterkrankungen oder anderen psychischen Belastungen.

Unser Ziel ist klar: Psychotherapeutische Versorgung soll zugänglicher, messbarer und skalierbarer werden. Für Patient:innen, für Therapeut:innen und für ein Gesundheitssystem, das neue Lösungen braucht, statt nur längere Wartelisten zu verwalten.

Du arbeitest bei uns an der Schnittstelle von Technik, Psychologie, MedTech und Virtual Reality. Dabei unterstützt du uns bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer VR-Anwendungen, beim Testen und Optimieren unserer Software und Hardware, bei KI-Experimenten und der Evaluation neuer VR-Technologien sowie bei der Frage, wie digitale Therapie technisch zuverlässig und sinnvoll in den klinischen Alltag integriert werden kann. Du bist nicht nur dabei, sondern arbeitest aktiv an Themen mit, die für Therapeut:innen und Patient:innen einen echten Unterschied machen können.

Tasks

Je nach aktuellen Projekten unterstützt du uns unter anderem bei:

  • der Weiterentwicklung und Anpassung unserer VR-Szenarien in Unity: Du setzt kleinere Features um und behebst Bugs

  • Software Testing & QA: Du testest Szenarien, dokumentierst Bugs und führst Regressionstests durch

  • der Einrichtung und Pflege unserer VR-Hardware: Du setzt Headsets auf, installierst und aktualisierst Software und prüfst, ob alles zuverlässig läuft

  • technischer Dokumentation: Du pflegst Anleitungen, Testprotokolle und Entwicklerdokumentation, damit Wissen im Team nicht verloren geht

  • der Integration und Optimierung von 3D-Assets sowie einfachen Animationen

  • KI-Experimenten: Du evaluierst KI-Tools für 360°-Umgebungen und VR-Inhalte und baust erste Prototypen

  • Performance-Analysen: Du untersuchst Framerate, Ladezeiten und Standalone-Performance

  • Automatisierung: Du schreibst kleine Skripte für Tests und wiederkehrende Prozesse

  • technischem Support: Du reproduzierst Probleme und analysierst technische Fehler

  • Recherchen zu neuen VR-Technologien, Unity-Tools und Integrationen

  • Themen, die im Hintergrund wichtig sind und für die Weiterentwicklung unserer Technologie einen echten Unterschied machen

Requirements

  • Du studierst Informatik, Medieninformatik, Game Development, Software Engineering oder ein vergleichbares Fach

  • Du suchst ein Pflichtpraktikum, bei dem du nicht nur zuschaust, sondern wirklich mitarbeitest

  • Du bringst Programmiergrundlagen in mindestens einer Sprache mit, idealerweise C#

  • Softwareentwicklung, Virtual Reality, DeepTech/ DeepMind und XR findest du spannend

  • Du denkst mit, stellst gute Fragen und möchtest Dinge verstehen und verbessern

  • Struktur, Eigeninitiative und Zuverlässigkeit sind für dich selbstverständlich und du gehst Probleme lösungsorientiert an

  • Du würdest gern in einem kleinen, interdisziplinären Team aus Tech, Psychologie und Forschung arbeiten

  • Deutsch und Englisch sind für dich kein Problem, auch für technische Dokumentation

  • Du hast schon erste Erfahrungen mit VR Entwicklung gesammelt

  • Erfahrung mit Unity und C#, Meta Quest/OpenXR, Blender oder anderen 3D-Tools, Git, Python, Debugging und Softwaretests oder generativer KI/LLMs ist wünschenswert. Auch Interesse an Digital Health und Psychologie freut uns

  • Dein Lebenslauf muss nicht perfekt sein. Viel wichtiger sind Neugier, Eigeninitiative und echtes Interesse

Benefits

Bei PsyCurio tauchst du tief in die Welt eines HealthTech-Startups ein, das Psychologie, Virtual Reality, Forschung und MedTech zusammenbringt. Du arbeitest an Themen mit direkter Relevanz für die psychotherapeutische Versorgung und bekommst Einblick in Produktentwicklung, wissenschaftliche Fragestellungen und kliniknahe Anwendungen.

Das Praktikum ist unvergütet. Dafür erlebst du das rasante Tempo eines Startups, übernimmst von Anfang an Verantwortung und bringst deine eigenen Ideen ein. Die Wege sind kurz, der Austausch ist direkt und du sitzt nicht nur in Meetings, sondern bewegst wirklich etwas.

Du arbeitest bei uns vollständig remote und kannst das Praktikum in Vollzeit für bis zu drei Monate oder entsprechend länger in Teilzeit absolvieren. Abschluss- oder Projektarbeiten sind nach Absprache ebenfalls möglich. Wenn es für beide Seiten passt, sprechen wir gern über eine weitere Zusammenarbeit, zum Beispiel als Werkstudent:in.

Klingt spannend? Dann erzähl uns, warum du Lust hast, bei PsyCurio dabei zu sein, was dich an Virtual Reality, MedTech oder digitaler Gesundheit fasziniert und wie du unser Team unterstützen kannst. Schick uns gern Links zu deinem Portfolio, deinem GitHub-Profil oder einem VR-Projekt, auf das du stolz bist.

Together with your future colleagues, we build technology that takes the burden off patients and healthcare professionals, creating more space for care. As an Android Developer, you will help make this happen by building and improving the mobile applications that connect people, devices and healthcare.

We create technology to make healthcare more accessible, as our digital health solutions help healthcare professionals monitor patients remotely, so people can receive the right care in the right place. As an Android Developer at Luscii, you will build and improve the mobile applications that make this possible.

Your work goes beyond writing code. You will help shape technical direction, share your expertise with colleagues and explore new technologies that can improve our apps. The applications you build need to work reliably in a healthcare context, where stability and usability matter. By combining solid engineering with thoughtful technical choices, you will help us continue to develop its digital healthcare platform.

As Android Developer at Luscii, you will combine hands-on development with technical ownership, working closely with colleagues across development, QA and support to build, improve and maintain our applications. Why Luscii?

Most important benefits

  • Remote-first: Work from anywhere in The Netherlands. We stay connected through monthly in-person team days called Assemblii.

  • Flexible setup: Create your own ideal workspace. Whatever works best for you - we’ve got you covered here.

The ideal candidate…

You enjoy the autonomy to shape your work and responsibilities, while actively seeking collaboration and alignment with others.

You know when to step up, when to involve colleagues and when to move forward decisively. Working independently does not mean working in isolation for you. You feel at ease being both a self-starter and a committed team player, contributing to shared goals while taking responsibility for your own domain. We come up with new ideas, identify the most impactful ones, test them, measure, iterate, or drop them and rerun the entire sprint. Your north star: helping our portfolio founders succeed through intros, hires, and any other random request. We measure ourselves on support per euro invested. You run multiple outbound campaigns in parallel, from sourcing and outreach to the final intro, and learn each field well enough to find the best talent. Sometimes that means building teams from zero for our incubation projects; previous ones: Telura (deep geothermal) and Starforge (fusion energy).

  • Content and website: You turn the technical and industry expertise from First Momentum's investment team and portfolio news (funding rounds, launches, technical results) into content for LinkedIn, our blog, and our newsletter. You also own our Webflow site and how AI search finds us.

  • European deep tech community: You grow our community of 100+ technical Venture Scouts and bring them into hiring and deals. You support in-person events like our annual meeting and help co-organize the European Spinoff Summit in Munich.

Work with people building fusion reactors and foundation models

You see what comes straight out of research labs long before most people meet it in a product.

New tools, workflows, and formats. If it works, it stays. You'll have few meetings, coordinate mostly async, and plan your own week.

Recruiting, content, design, web, and AI tooling. Most people with 1–2 years of experience get to work in one of them.
